title: F1 领队模拟器 · F1 电视转播风格 UI 重设计
summary: Single direction: an F1 TV broadcast-graphics look with a dark carbon-fibre surface, glowing player-team colour (--team), bold italic condensed headings, skewed lower-third tags and short CSS motion that honours reduced motion. The desktop panel (980×720) adds a left timing tower: standings on non-race screens, live race order during a weekend. Phones (390×844) use a collapsed header, a 40px collapsible timing-tower strip that slides the full tower out when opened, and a 6-tab bottom bar (总览/比赛周末/车手/赛车/研发/更多; 更多 holds 积分榜 and 存档与设置). R&D is built around a clickable top-down car drawing coloured by part performance, plus the new ADUO card; a customer-team phone variant shows PU/ERS locked. The in-chat HUD keeps every current field in a compact carbon strip with a team-colour edge. Shared assets not linked as variations: tokens.css (all tokens, same variable names as the current panel) and car-topdown.svg (standalone drawing with part ids and state classes). The product is dark-only, so there are no light-theme files. Sample data is illustrative (Aston Martin, Honda ADUO tier 2, Monaco round 8).
